scripts.build: pnpm --filter @netokay/contracts build && pnpm --filter @netokay/core build && pnpm --filter netokay build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @netokay/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @netokay/core typecheck && pnpm --filter netokay typecheck
scripts.pack: pnpm build && mkdir -p .release-pack && cd apps/cli && npm pack --json --pack-destination ../../.release-pack
